response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT m.Name AS name, AVG(1.0 * tr.Bytes / tr.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Track tr JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = tr.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), o AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS overall FROM t) SELECT AVG(t.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(t.cnt) AS avg_track_count, AVG(t.rate - o.overall) AS avg_excess FROM t CROSS JOIN o WHERE t.rate > o.overall

assumptions.assumption: Track count is the count of all tracks linked to the media type (including tracks with NULL Bytes), while the rate average ignores tracks with NULL Bytes. A media type whose tracks all have NULL Bytes has a NULL rate and is excluded by the comparison (but still counts as a group in the overall average only if its rate is non-NULL, since AVG skips NULLs).
Milliseconds is assumed to be non-zero (it is NOT NULL); the division uses 1.0 multiplication to avoid integer division.

alternatives.interpretation: Track count only counts tracks with a non-NULL Bytes value (the same tracks that contribute to the rate).
